claims.summary: Solar and orbital physics confirm Earth cannot experience global darkness for multiple consecutive days.
claims.why_this_result: Earth continues rotating continuously on its axis relative to the Sun; total solar eclipses only darken narrow geographic swaths for mere minutes.

claims.summary: Earth rotates eastward in an invariant prograde direction determined by planetary conservation of angular momentum.
claims.why_this_result: Reversing planetary rotation would require catastrophic kinetic impact with a planetary mass body, which has not occurred.

claims.summary: The Moon's regolith surface reflects sunlight without chromatic filtering to green; lunar surface remains grey-brown basaltic and anorthositic rock.
claims.why_this_result: Astronomical ephemerides and spectroscopic data confirm optical properties of lunar reflection contain zero green wavelength emissions.
